card.summary: Lets an agent run small calculations on the data you give it, instead of doing the arithmetic in its head.
card.example: The agent totals the lines on an expense claim and shows its working.
cost: Billed for each session the agent opens.
needs: Nothing to set up in the Lab. It is a built-in Foundry tool.
card.safety: It runs in a sandbox managed by Foundry and only sees the data it is given.
card.service: Foundry Agent Service code interpreter tool
card.note: Prefer the tools Foundry already provides over rebuilding them in the Lab.
